title: Horizon Implementation Day: Grant Agreement Preparation in Horizon Europe
organiser: European Commission, DG Research and Innovation
summary: What happens after a proposal is selected: the grant agreement preparation process, legal and financial validation, the Description of Action and the most common errors.
covers: An overview of the grant agreement preparation (GAP) process
Legal validation and financial capacity assessment by the Research Executive Agency's Central Validation Service
Writing the scientific and technical Description of Action
Legal and financial aspects, and how to avoid common errors
materials: Agenda and presentation slides for each session
why: Grant preparation runs on tight deadlines and errors delay the start of the project. Coordinators should go through these slides as soon as they receive an invitation to prepare the grant.
source_name: European Commission · Research and innovation community platform (related webinars)
